# Mattra Inc.

> Maine's whole-home experts. Mold remediation, insulation, construction, and consulting — diagnosed as one system, fixed by one team. Over 30 years of experience. Efficiency Maine Registered Vendor. IICRC and BPI certified.

## Company Info

- Name: Mattra Inc.
- Phone: (207) 777-6020
- Location: Lewiston, Maine
- Service Area: All of Maine
- Website: https://www.mattrainc.com
- Google Rating: 4.9 stars (62+ reviews)
- Certifications: IICRC Certified, BPI Certified, Efficiency Maine Registered Vendor, Maine Licensed Contractor

## What Makes Mattra Different

Most contractors treat symptoms — they remove mold, add insulation, or repair rot in isolation. Mattra diagnoses root causes. Moisture, air leakage, insulation gaps, ventilation failures, and structural damage are connected systems. Mattra finds the root cause, corrects it, and verifies the fix with one coordinated team. No subcontracting, no hand-offs.

## Services

### Mold
- [Mold Removal & Remediation](https://www.mattrainc.com/mold/removal-remediation/): Full IICRC-certified remediation addressing the moisture source, not just visible mold
- [Mold Inspection & Testing](https://www.mattrainc.com/mold/inspection-testing/): Professional inspection with lab-tested air and surface sampling
- [Real Estate Mold Transactions](https://www.mattrainc.com/mold/real-estate-transactions/): Fast mold clearance for buyers, sellers, and realtors on tight closing timelines

### Insulation
- [Attic Insulation](https://www.mattrainc.com/insulation/attic/): Blown-in and spray foam attic insulation with air sealing
- [Crawl Space Encapsulation](https://www.mattrainc.com/insulation/crawl-space/): Vapor barriers, insulation, and moisture control
- [Wall Insulation](https://www.mattrainc.com/insulation/wall/): Dense-pack cellulose and retrofit installs for existing homes
- [Basement Insulation](https://www.mattrainc.com/insulation/basement/): Spray foam, wall, and rim joist insulation
- [Spray Foam Insulation](https://www.mattrainc.com/insulation/spray-foam/): Closed-cell and open-cell spray foam
- [Blown-In Insulation](https://www.mattrainc.com/insulation/blown-in/): Cellulose and fiberglass blown-in installation
- [Air Sealing](https://www.mattrainc.com/insulation/air-sealing/): Home envelope air sealing to stop drafts and energy loss

### Construction
- [Roofing](https://www.mattrainc.com/construction/roofing/): Roof repair and replacement
- [Siding](https://www.mattrainc.com/construction/siding/): Siding installation and repair
- [Rot Repair](https://www.mattrainc.com/construction/rot-repair/): Structural wood rot repair
- [Repair & Rebuild](https://www.mattrainc.com/construction/repair-rebuild/): Repair and rebuild after damage
- [Water Damage Repair](https://www.mattrainc.com/construction/water-damage/): Water damage restoration
- [Basement Waterproofing](https://www.mattrainc.com/construction/basement-waterproofing/): Basement waterproofing systems
- [Ventilation](https://www.mattrainc.com/construction/ventilation/): Attic and whole-home ventilation
- [Demolition](https://www.mattrainc.com/construction/demolition/): Selective and full demolition

### Consulting
- [Building Inspections](https://www.mattrainc.com/consulting/building-inspections/): Independent building science inspections
- [Buying & Selling Real Estate](https://www.mattrainc.com/consulting/buying-selling-real-estate/): Pre-purchase and pre-sale home assessments

## Efficiency Maine Rebates

Mattra is a registered Efficiency Maine vendor. Maine homeowners can receive rebates up to $8,000 for qualifying insulation and air sealing work. Mattra handles the paperwork and rebate application process.

- [Efficiency Maine Rebates](https://www.mattrainc.com/efficiency-maine/)
- [Rebate Calculator](https://www.mattrainc.com/rebate-calculator/)
- [Financing & Rebates](https://www.mattrainc.com/financing-rebates/)
